class.name: JRPGEvent
class.brief_description: A map event on the running map.
class.description: The node a [JRPGSceneManager] builds for each [JRPGEventData] of the map it shows, inside the map. It shows its active page's graphic at its cell: a character from its sheet facing the page's direction and showing its frame, or a tile of the map's tileset; nothing when no page qualifies or once the event is erased. Its z follows the page's priority ([constant JRPGMap.Z_BELOW], [constant JRPGMap.Z_CHARACTERS] or [constant JRPGMap.Z_ABOVE]). An event Same as characters that is not through stops characters stepping onto its cell. Its cell, facing and erased flag are the game state's [JRPGEventState], so a save keeps them; when its page changes it faces the new page's direction. Authority: server. Online, the zone decides the page and the position; this node only shows them.

method.name: blocks_characters
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when characters cannot step onto the event's cell: it is present, its page is Same as characters, and neither the page nor a move route makes it pass through.

method.name: get_cell_size
method.description: Returns the size of the map's cells, in pixels.

method.name: get_direction
method.description: Returns the direction the event faces.

method.name: get_mover
method.description: Returns the [JRPGMover] that holds the event's cell and facing.

method.name: get_page
method.description: Returns the active page, or [code]null[/code] when no page qualifies.

method.name: get_page_index
method.description: Returns the index of the active page, or [code]-1[/code] when no page qualifies.

method.name: get_state
method.description: Returns the event's state in the game state (cell, facing, erased), which saves keep.

method.name: is_present
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the event shows: a page qualifies and the event is not erased.

method.name: refresh_page
method.description: Picks the active page in [param game_state] on map [param map_id] and shows it; returns [code]true[/code] when the page changed. The scene manager does this at most once per simulation step, when the game state changed.

method.name: set_cell_size
method.description: Sets the size of the map's cells, in pixels.

method.name: update_position
method.description: Moves the node to where its mover is.
